desc: The SW22 VICTORY is constructed on a single-action, enclosed hammer-fired, blowback semi-automatic design. Chambered in .22 LR, the SW22 Victory comes highly featured with innovative design qualities that include a match-grade, interchangeable barrel for superb accuracy on the range or in the field along with a simple one-screw takedown design. The pistol's high-end features, modern styling and enriched functionality place the SW22 Victory in a category of its own with an affordable price to match.
